adorablehamsterpets.main.acornDropChance: Die Wahrscheinlichkeit (0.0 bis 1.0) dass eine Eichel erscheint, wenn dein Hamster wühlt. Der Standard ist sehr niedrig bei 0.03 (3%), da der Hamster ungefähr ~5 mal pro Sekunde wühlt. Dreh den Wert auf, wenn du die lokale Wirtschaft der Eichhörnchen in den Ruin stürzen willst. (Die Maximale Ausgabe ist 1. Eichel pro Sekunde, auch wenn du es ganz hochdrehst).
adorablehamsterpets.main.actionBarDurati: Die Dauer (in Ticks), die Nachrichten in der Aktionsleiste auf dem Bildschirm bleiben. Beeinflusst nur deinen Computer. In Vanilla sind es 60 (3 Sekunden), was kaum genug Zeit ist, um zu checken, dass da was steht. Gebe dir mehr Zeit, um den Text zu bewahren. (20 Ticks = 1 Sekunde).
adorablehamsterpets.main.allowSleepInBed: Die globale Einstellung, die entscheidet, ob die Hamster in ihren Betten schlafen können. Wenn aktiviert, suchen alle Hamster im Wandermodus sich ein Bett, um zu bestimmten Zeiten zu schlafen, unabhängig von den Einstellungen der einzelnen Betten. Wenn deaktiviert, kippen sie einfach im Sitzen um, wie dein Bierbauch Onkel beim Familiengrillen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.announcements.d: Schalte das Glöckchen ein, das erscheint, wenn ich dir etwas ganz Wichtiges zu erzählen habe. Oder schalte Sie eben aus, du Spaßbremse.
adorablehamsterpets.main.armorPerks.desc: Configure the buffs provided by specific armor materials. For Diamond armor perk configuration, remove or add items to the 'Retrievable Items' list in 'Core Item Tag Overrides.'
adorablehamsterpets.main.armorSettings.d: Hier machst du deine Rüstung OP. Oder schalte es aus. Mir doch egal.
adorablehamsterpets.main.autoHealFoods.d: Die bestimmten Gegenstände, die ein Hamster direkt aus seiner Wange isst, um seine eigenen Verletzungen zu heilen. Suche dir bestimmte Speisen aus, oder lass sie deine Zauber-Äpfel verschwinden lassen. Deine Wahl.
adorablehamsterpets.main.avoidUnlinkedBe: Sollten Hamster die Betten voneinander behandeln wie ein Tempel? Wenn ja, suchen sie höflich einen weg drum-herum, aber geben auf, wenn ihre Nagetier-Geduld nachlässt. Wenn nein, dann trampeln sie herum, wie und wo sie wollen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.bedAvoidanceFoo: Eine Liste von bestimmten Gegenständen, die, bei Anwendung auf einem Hamster-Bettchen, die Einstellungen 'Wandermodus Einstellungen > Schlafen im Bett erlauben' deaktivieren. Für den Fall, dass du deinen Hamster auf Dauer wachhalten willst... warum auch immer. Dies kann rückgängig gemacht werden, indem du einen anlockenden Gegenstand (standardmäßig Käse) auf dem Bett anwendest. Schleichen, bevor du mit diesem Gegenstand rechts-klickst, wird das Bett vollständig zurücksetzen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.bedWakeUpCooldo: Die obligatorische Morgenmuffel-Zeit, wenn du einen Hamster frühreif aus dem Schlaf zerrst. Er schläft erst wieder ein, wenn diese Zeit rum ist. (20 Ticks = 1 Sekunde)
adorablehamsterpets.main.breedingCooldow: Hamster brauchen Zeit für sich. (20 Ticks = 1 s)
adorablehamsterpets.main.buffFoods.desc: Die Liste fragwürdiger Stoffe, die deinem Hamster kurzlebige Superkräfte leihen. Standardmäßig sind es nur gedämpfte grüne Bohnen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.celebrationOres: The list of blocks that smell... shiny. Especially to greedy hamsters. Diamonds by default, but maybe you want them to sniff for Zinc ore? Accepts block IDs (e.g. 'create:zinc_ore') and #tags (e.g. '#c:ores/diamond').
adorablehamsterpets.main.cheeseHealing.d: Käse.... das Wundermittel. Manche denken er ist zu mächtig. Das streite Ich natürlich ab.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cheeseNutrition: Wie viel Hunger der Käse wiederherstellt. Vanilla gekochtes Steak stellt 8 wieder her. Ich rieche, dass du es auf 20 stellen willst, du Schlingel.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cheeseSaturatio: Wie lange die Sättigung bleibt. Gekochtes Steak hat 0,8. Übertreibe es nicht. Oder doch. Mir egal.
Findest du den Schlafrhythmus deines Hamsters überbewertet? Wenn aktiviert, schläft dein Hamster während unberechenbaren Zeiten. Die Aktivierung überschreibt die 'Schlafen während des Tages' Einstellung.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cleaningChanceD: Wie oft ein sitzender Hamster sich plötzlich putzen will. Die Wahrscheinlichkeit ist eine 1-zu-X Chance pro Tick, also desto niedriger die Zahl, desto höher die Wahrscheinlichkeit. Zum Beispiel, bei 1200 würde sich der Hamster etwa ein mal pro Minute putzen. 300 ≈ alle 15 Sekunden, 5000 ≈ alle 4 Minuten. Viel Spaß mit der Info.
adorablehamsterpets.main.commissionedFea: Specialized, unofficial mechanics that don't necessarily fit the theme of the mod, but were funded by various individuals in the community. Purposefully tucked away in the config to ensure most people don't notice them.
adorablehamsterpets.main.consumeLureItem: Soll ein Hamster den verlockenden Gegenstand (z.B. Käse) auf deiner Schulter mampfen? Deaktiviere diese Einstellung, wenn du denkst, dass du anziehend genug bist. Der Gegenstand bleibt benötigt, wird aber nicht gefressen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.cooldowns.desc: Die Verdi Hamster-Streiks zwischen coolen Stunts.
adorablehamsterpets.main.core.desc: Grundlegende Hamster-Streiche – Herumfummeln auf eigene Gefahr.
adorablehamsterpets.main.creativeWidgetI: Steuere die Position des Icons in der Kreativmodus-GUI. Denn nichts sagt mehr ‚Immersion‘ als eine perfekt ausgerichtete Benachrichtigungsglocke. Die Position ist relativ zur oberen rechten Ecke der GUI.
adorablehamsterpets.main.debugTreeDetect: Shows visual particles for the detected Tree ID (the lowest block of the trunk) and leaf canopy during a heist, and turns on extra logging in the console. Useful for seeing exactly which tree your hamster is searching and/or debugging if things are being weird.
adorablehamsterpets.main.defaultWanderDi: Die anfängliche Wanderentfernung, die festgelegt wird, wenn ein Hamster erstmals mit einem Bett verknüpft wird. Standardmäßig ist sie auf Mittel gesetzt, weil das der universell akzeptierte Ausgangspunkt für alle Lebensentscheidungen ist.
adorablehamsterpets.main.desc: Das Kommandozentrum für nagetierbasiertes Chaos. Passe die Physik an, schwäche Käse ab und spiele ganz allgemein Gott mit kleinen, pelzigen Kreaturen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.diamondSeekRadi: Wie weit (in Blöcken) ein Hamster scannt, nachdem er sich entscheiden hat Erzsucher zu spielen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.disableWildLoot: Deaktiviere das Erscheinen von wildem Loot
If true, wild hamsters take their cheek-treasures to the grave. Prevents players from creating 'ethical' hamster recycling farms for seeds and nuggets.
adorablehamsterpets.main.dismountOrder.d: Determines the sequence for dismounting hamsters with a key press. LIFO (Last-In, First-Out) dismounts the most recently added hamster. FIFO (First-In, First-Out) dismounts the oldest one.
adorablehamsterpets.main.dismountPressTy: Choose whether a single press or a quick double‑tap dismounts the hamster.
adorablehamsterpets.main.dismountTrigger: Choose what action dismounts the hamster. 'SNEAK_KEY' uses your sneak key, obviously. 'CUSTOM_KEYBIND' uses a separate key you must set in Controls > Key Binds.
adorablehamsterpets.main.doubleTapDelayT: Max time between sneak key presses to count as a double-tap. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableArmorPerk: If true, upgraded armor grants special perks. If false (because you hate fun?), armor acts only as a damage shield/visual. Each perk can also be individually configured in 'Armor Settings.'
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableArmorVisu: Master switch for armor rendering. If false, hamsters will appear unarmored even when equipped. Useful if you prefer the natural look but still want the protection.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableAutoGuide: Hand-delivers the sacred texts on first login.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableBedBreakM: Erhalte eine Nachricht in der Aktionsleiste, wenn das Bett deines Hamsters zerstört wurde. Hier kannst du es ausschalten, wenn du willst... komplette Immersion.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableDynamicDr: Should the gentle, drift of Hamster Bedding leaf particles slowly change direction over time? If true, it's a slow, majestic rotation. (It takes a bout 3 minutes to make a full 360 degree rotation). If false, you get to pick a static wind direction below.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableDynamicSh: If true, hamsters on your shoulder will randomly cycle through standing, sitting, and laying down while on the shoulder. If false, they will remain in a single state defined below.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableHudIcon.d: Decide if the bell haunts you full-time on the HUD or only ambushes you when you're trying to organize your inventory. If disabled, you will only see notifications when you open an inventory.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableIndepende: Force a cool-down after striking it rich. Off by default, since this can't happen again anyway without another mount/dismount on the shoulder.
Den Hamstern erlauben, sich auf werd-schnell-reich Alleingänge zu begeben?
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableItemCarry: Permits hamsters to engage in spontaneous, high-stakes games of keep-away with your valuables, or they might fetch items for you.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableItemToolt: Hilfreiches Flüstern darüber, wozu diese verdammte Gurke gut ist.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableJadeHamst: Mehr Stats als man sich wünschen könnte. Standardmäßig aus— gnädigerweise.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableMountable:
Adds a keybind to mount hamsters. (It's unbound by default). Allows riding any hamster, but you can only steer your own. 

Commissioned by @Saint_Victus.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableNotificat: The master switch for all announcement notifications. Turning this off is the same as clicking 'Disable All' in the announcement screen. Announcements can still be viewed in the §f§lHamster Tips§r guide book.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRavagerFl: Sollten Verwüster, die gewaltigen Bestien der Zerstörung, vor einen kleinen Fellball in Furcht fliehen? Ja. Ja, das sollten sie.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableRespawnIn: The Master Switch. Affects all Hamster Beds. If true, hamsters linked to a bed can be resurrected there. Cheating? Maybe. Convenient? Absolutely.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableShoulderC: Könnte dein Inventar retten. Oder deine Ohren.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableShoulderD: Denn wer genießt es nicht ungebetene Finanzberatung von einem Nager zu erhalten?
Kleine Statusmeldung, wenn dein Co-Pilot absteigt.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableShoulderM: Tired of wasting perfectly good cheese? Enable this to use a dedicated keybind (unbound by default). Hold down this key while right-clicking your hamster to hoist them onto your shoulder, no questions asked. Uses a separate key you must set in Settings > Controls > Key Binds.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableSpiderFle: Verwandelt deinen Hamster in eine mobile Arachniden-Abwehreinheit. Höchst effektiv.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableTreeHeist: Gibt an, ob eine Nachricht auf der Aktionsleiste angezeigt wird, wenn ein Baumheist beginnt.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableWanderMod: Wenn du etwas persönlichen Freiraum brauchst. Erlaubt dir gezähmte Hamster an ein Bett zu verknüpfen, damit sie in einem Radius frei herumlaufen können, anstatt wie geschmolzenes Panzerband an dir zu kleben. Gern geschehen.
adorablehamsterpets.main.enableWidgetIco: Decide if the bell icon should ambush you while you're sorting your inventory. If disabled, it will only bother you on the main menu or the game HUD if you have those enabled. Your screen, your rules.
adorablehamsterpets.main.foodHealing.des: Ernährung— ist es nicht wundervoll. Anpassungen an Snacks.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forceLayDownOnS: Falls aktiviert, werden Hamster auf der Schulter beim Sprinten in ihre 'hinlegen' Animation versetzt, als würden sie sich um ihr Leben festhalten. Falls nicht aktiviert, gehen die Hamster ihre normalen Animationen durch.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forceLayDownOnW: False by default. If true, shoulder hamsters will be forced into their 'laying down' animation when you move, as if trying not to fall off. If false, they will continue their normal animation cycle.
adorablehamsterpets.main.forcedShoulderS: If dynamic animations are disabled, choose the single state shoulder pets should remain in. Sometimes this setting can have a delay before kicking in, but if it doesn't seem to be working at all, try switching the 'Forced State' from one option to another. Usually this just makes it "work." I'm not sure why lol
adorablehamsterpets.main.goldArmorSpeedB: The zoom factor provided by Gold Armor. Because flimsier things go faster. Obviously. (+0.20 = +20% Speed)
adorablehamsterpets.main.goldMistakeChan: The probability (0.0 to 1.0) that a hamster will seek gold instead of diamond, if both are available. At 0.5, it's a coin toss. At 1.0, it's guaranteed hamster sulking.
adorablehamsterpets.main.greenBeanBuffAm: Extra fluff padding for those daring dives.
adorablehamsterpets.main.greenBeanBuffDu: Steamed beans: power that fades faster than your attention span. (20 ticks = 1 second)
Nutrition, but make it dramatic. Tweaks to caffeine-bean highs.
adorablehamsterpets.main.guidebookSettin: Settings related to the 'Hamster Tips' guide book and how aggressively I nag you about it.
adorablehamsterpets.main.guidebookWarnin: How long (in ticks) I wait before realizing you're book-less and panicking. 3600 = 3 minutes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterAttribut: All the knobs and dials that make your hamster the majestic (or chaotic) creature it is.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterFoodMixH: Healing amount from Hamster Food Mix. The good stuff.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterRiding.d: Configure hamster-mounted cavalry. Tweak speeds, toggles, and physics. Don't blame me if you accidentally zoom off a cliff after turning up the speed too high.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowCoo: Time-out after using your living projectile. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowDam: Damage dealt by thrown hamster. Surprisingly effective against Creepers. How convenient.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hamsterThrowVel: The base throw speed of your furry projectile.
The throw speed of your furry projectile when under the influence of Steamed Green Beans. Goes from 'yeet' to 'yote'.
adorablehamsterpets.main.helpAndResource: Buttons for when you’re lost, bored, or met a bug that’s not just existential hamster angst.
Shove the icon horizontally. For when 'top-left' isn't specific enough for your discerning taste.
Adjust the vertical placement. Does it block your view? Is it not blocking your view enough? The power is yours.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hudIconPosition: Banish the bell to a corner of your choosing. It's your screen. Establish dominance.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hudIconScale.de: Make it bigger. Make it smaller. Make it an affront to good taste. I'm not your art director.
adorablehamsterpets.main.hudIconSettings: Options for the little bell with hamster ears that just hangs out in the corner of your screen when notifications are pending.
adorablehamsterpets.main.independentDiam: Unleash free-range prospectors. What could go wrong?
adorablehamsterpets.main.independentOreS: Cooldown before your hamster can go on another treasure hunt. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.ironArmorThrowS: Aerodynamics provided by smooth Iron plating. Adds 0.5 to the throw velocity, which is 1.5 by default or 2.5 when under the influence of Steamed Green Beans.
adorablehamsterpets.main.itemInterest.de: For when your hamster develops a taste for the finer things in life. Can be configured so they steal or fetch any item— even from other mods. They steal diamonds and fetch acorns by default.
adorablehamsterpets.main.itemTags.desc: For the advanced user who looks at a perfectly functional system and thinks, 'I can make this weirder.' Edit these lists to change what items your hamsters consider food, bait, treasure, and all other interactions. Use item IDs (e.g., 'minecraft:diamond') or tags (e.g., '#minecraft:fishes'). Mess it up? That's a you problem.
adorablehamsterpets.main.itemThieveryCha: Probability (0.1 to 1.0) a hamster will succumb to temptation. High by default. You shouldn't leave your diamonds lying around anyway. Does not apply to retrieval.
adorablehamsterpets.main.keepHamstersOnS: If true, any hamsters on your shoulder will remain there when you respawn. If false (default), they will remain at your death location, passed out from the sheer shock of seeing you die. They may need a quick pat to wake them up when you return.
How loud the wind gust sound effect is, for you overachievers who are running 15 different sound physics mods. 1.0 is default, 0.0 is silent.
The minimum time (in ticks) your hamster stares into your soul. Actual duration = this value + a random extra 0 to 4 seconds. Default is 40. Increase to simulate deep contemplation (or emptiness).
adorablehamsterpets.main.lureItems.desc: The specific items that convince a tamed hamster your shoulder is the best seat in the house. Also acts as a bribe to lure them into their linked bed. Defaults to cheese, because of course it does.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxFleeDistance: The maximum distance (in blocks) before the hamster gets bored and stops running to taunt you with the stolen goods. The discrepancy between the minimum and maximum flee distance determines the randomness.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxNapInBedInte: The longest amount of time (in seconds) a hamster can possibly stay awake or asleep in bed before it gets bored and switches things up. Defaults to 10 minutes.
adorablehamsterpets.main.maxStealDuratio: The longest amount of time (in seconds) the hamster will entertain interest in an item before getting bored and dropping it. The discrepancy between the minimum and maximum duration determines the randomness.
adorablehamsterpets.main.meleeDamage.des: Tamed hamster melee damage. Squeak-first, ask questions later.
adorablehamsterpets.main.minFleeDistance: The hamster's personal space bubble (in blocks) when stealing your shinies. The discrepancy between the minimum and maximum flee distance determines the randomness.
adorablehamsterpets.main.minNapInBedInte: The shortest possible time (in seconds) a hamster will stay awake or asleep in bed before considering a change. Defaults to 5 minutes— for the truly narcoleptic rodent. A random duration between the min and max is chosen each time, so move them further apart for more... unpredictable behavior.
adorablehamsterpets.main.minStealDuratio: The shortest amount of time (in seconds) the hamster will entertain interest in an item before getting bored and dropping it. The discrepancy between the minimum and maximum duration determines the randomness.
adorablehamsterpets.main.mobInteractions: Configure how hamsters interact with (or terrify) other creatures.
adorablehamsterpets.main.mountPriority.d: Where should the hamster go first? 'Shoulders First' fills Right then Left then Head. 'Head First' fills Head then Right then Left.
adorablehamsterpets.main.netheriteArmorK: The 'Immovable Object' density factor. 0.5 is 50% resistance. 1.0 makes them a neutron star.
adorablehamsterpets.main.netheriteArmorT: Heavy things hit harder. Adds this much flat damage to the projectile impact. (1 = 0.5 hearts)
adorablehamsterpets.main.particleEffects: Here's where you tweak the behavior of the floaty leaf particles spawned from Hamster Bedding. Didn't know you could spawn particles from Hamster Bedding? Try to keep up.
adorablehamsterpets.main.playersWhoHaveS: A list of UUIDs for players who have already seen the missing guidebook warning. Ensures that everyone sees this, but only once unless you delete your name from this list.
adorablehamsterpets.main.pouchAllowedIte: A specific list of items and tags that are allowed in the hamster's cheek pouch. You can add things to this list to bypass the default 'no tools or big blocks' rule, since this overrides the 'disallowed' settings.
adorablehamsterpets.main.pouchDisallowed: A list of specific item IDs that are NEVER allowed in the cheek pouch, unless they are on the 'Allowed' list above. Mostly stuff that's too big, too pointy, or just plain illogical. Lol.
A list of item tags that are NEVER allowed in the cheek pouch, unless they are on the 'Allowed' list above. A broad-spectrum approach to preventing your hamster from swallowing an entire sword.
adorablehamsterpets.main.pouchRestrictio: Fine-tune exactly what your hamster is (and isn't) allowed to carry. The 'Allowed' list acts as a high-priority override to the 'Disallowed' lists and general rules.
adorablehamsterpets.main.pouchUnlockFood: The one-time offering required to earn a hamster's ultimate trust, unlocking their cheek inventory. Make it something special. Or don't. See if I care.
Determines whether you are able to see the jaunty little Acorn Hat when hamsters are wearing the base Acorn Armor. Does not affect what other players see, and does not apply to the standalone Acorn Hat accessory.
adorablehamsterpets.main.repeatableFoods: Items on this list are so delicious, your hamster will never refuse them, even if you feed it to them twice. For the truly spoiled rodent.
adorablehamsterpets.main.requireDaytimeF: Choose when your sitting hamster will succumb to drowsiness. 'True' means your sitting hamster will only doze off during the day— 'false' means it can doze off anytime. This setting does not affect the behavior of a hamster when sleeping in a bed.
adorablehamsterpets.main.requireFoodMixT: Require Food Mix to Unlock Cheeks
Gate cheek-pouch storage behind gourmet cuisine, because drama.
adorablehamsterpets.main.resurrectionTri: The specific items accepted by the Hamster Bed to enable the Respawn Protocol. Defaults to the Totem of Undying, because immortality isn't cheap. Accepts item IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:totem_of_undying') or tags.
adorablehamsterpets.main.retrievableItem: Items the hamster views as gifts or toys to bring back to you. Picking these up triggers Delivery Mode. Default: Acorns.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ridingBaseSpeed: The casual strolling speed multiplier. 0.25 is the default. Don't ask why.
adorablehamsterpets.main.ridingSprintSpe: The speed multiplier when sprinting. Hold on to your acorn hat. 0.35 is the default. I wish it was a nice round number, but alas, hamster riding is a complex enigma.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulder.desc: Settings for your fuzzy parrot of doom.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderAnimati: Control how lively your shoulder-mounted companions are. I mean, I don't like to toot my own horn or anything, but this is pretty great. Now please excuse me while I bask in my humility.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderAudio.d: For when the squeaks become... a bit much.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderCore.de: Just the basic stuff. You know, detecting creepers, sniffing diamonds. Just average Minecraft stuff really. No big deal. Why are you clapping and squealing? Stop that. You look silly.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderDiamond: How close (in blocks) you need to be before the squeak says "bling."
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderDismoun: Here's where you decide how to get the little rascals off your shoulders. Warning: they can be clingy.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderMaxStat: The maximum time (in seconds) a shoulder hamster will stay in any one animation state (standing, sitting, or laying down). A random duration between the min and max is chosen for each transition.
adorablehamsterpets.main.shoulderMinStat: The minimum time (in seconds) a shoulder hamster will stay in any one animation state (standing, sitting, or laying down). A random duration between the min and max is chosen for each transition.
adorablehamsterpets.main.silencePhysicsS: Mutes the hamster landing/bounce sound effect from the physics simulation when you are in first-person view.
adorablehamsterpets.main.silenceShoulder: Mutes the ambient squeaks from shoulder-mounted hamsters. The bounce and alert sounds will still play.
If false, wandering hamsters will sleep in their beds during the night. If true, they'll adopt a more nocturnal, goth-adjacent lifestyle and sleep in the daytime.
adorablehamsterpets.main.snoozeUpdateRem: For when you see the update notification and think, 'That's a problem for future me.' Future you will be so proud. This is where you select many days to hide the 'Update Available' notification when you click 'Remind Me Later'.
adorablehamsterpets.main.standardFoodHea: Healing from basic seeds/crops. Better than nothing… probably.
adorablehamsterpets.main.standardFoods.d: The hamster's everyday menu. These items will heal them or, if they're at full health, might give them... ideas about starting a family. Don't make it weird.
adorablehamsterpets.main.staticDriftAngl: Set a fixed direction for the universal leaf drift (0-360 degrees). 0 = South, 90 = West, 180 = North, 270 = East. Or just slide it until it looks cool. Whatever. Only works if 'Dynamic Drift' is off.
adorablehamsterpets.main.stealCooldownTi: Mandatory time-out after a successful heist to prevent serial kleptomania. (20 ticks = 1s). WARNING: Increasing this cooldown can dramatically change the item stealing mechanic, since that AI goal sometimes re-runs multiple times in a row when the hamster has trouble pathfinding to the item that it wants to steal. So instead of increasing this, you should probably just stop dropping your diamonds on the ground everywhere, butter fingers.
The list of items a hamster might try to... 'borrow' if you leave them on the ground. A chase will ensue. You have been warned.
adorablehamsterpets.main.steamedGreenBea: When the sugar rush ends, force a breather. (20 ticks = 1 second)
adorablehamsterpets.main.sulkingOres.des: Blocks that look promising but ultimately lead to a dramatic emotional breakdown. Gold by default, but if you want them to sniff for dirt, I'm not your conscience. Accepts block IDs (e.g. 'create:copper_ore') and #tags (e.g. '#c:ores/gold').
adorablehamsterpets.main.survivalWidgetI: Control the icon's placement for standard GUIs. Because nothing says 'immersion' like a perfectly aligned notification bell. Position is relative to the GUI's top-right corner.
How beefy your tamed fuzzball is. Defaults to double its wild health, because love makes you stronger. Or something. Vanilla wolves have 20 (10 hearts).
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamedQuiescentS: Maximum seconds before the inevitable deep snooze.
Minimum seconds before a sitting hamster gets sleepy.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamedSleepSetti: Even digital rodents need beauty sleep— adjust according to your patience levels.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamedSleepThrea: How close (in blocks) a hostile mob can get before a hamster wakes up from it's power nap.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamingChanceDen: Convince a hamster to love you. Taming difficulty (1 in X chance). Higher = more cucumbers sacrificed to fuzzy freeloaders.
adorablehamsterpets.main.tamingFoods.des: The official list of bribes for convincing wild fluffballs to join your cause. By default, it's just sliced cucumbers. Feel free to add 'minecraft:nether_star' if you enjoy making poor life choices. Compatible with Cultural Delights by default!
Changes the default entity name from 'Hamster' to 'Hampter'. Note: This has no visible effect in vanilla Minecraft, as mobs don't show nameplates by default. It's primarily for use with mods like Auto Leveling that display entity names.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderDistanceF: The radius (in blocks) for the 'Far' wander distance setting. For the adventurous hamster who might send you a postcard someday. Maybe.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderDistanceM: The radius (in blocks) for the 'Medium' wander distance setting. A respectable distance. Not too close, not too far. Perfectly balanced, as all things should be.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderDistanceN: The radius (in blocks) for the 'Near' wander distance setting. For the clingy hamster who wants freedom, but not too much.
Controls how frequently your hamster feels the urge to walk around. The higher the number, the lazier the hamster (1 in X chance to wander per tick; 20 ticks = 1 second). Set to 0 to disable wandering entirely— perfect for keeping them still for photoshoots or interrogation. Vanilla's default chance for Wolves is 1 in 120 ticks.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wanderMode.desc: For when 'following you into lava' is no longer a desirable trait. Tweak the settings for your hamster's newfound, bed-based independence.
adorablehamsterpets.main.widgetIconOffse: Shove it sideways (in pixels). Increase the number to move it right, decrease to move left.
Shove it vertically (in pixels). Increase the number to move it down, decrease to move up.
adorablehamsterpets.main.widgetIconSetti: Configure the bell with hamster ears that haunts the corners of your inventory screens.
adorablehamsterpets.main.wildMaxHealth.d: How much abuse a wild hamster can take before it gives up the ghost. Vanilla animals are around 8-10. Set it to 200 (100 hearts) if you enjoy a challenge, or 1 if you're a monster.
adorablehamsterpets.main.yeetSettings.de: For when you need a furry, surprisingly aerodynamic solution.
adorablehamsterpets.root.desc: Here's where your hamster experimentation begins. Don't forget to touch grass.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.accessoryLo: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find accessories in rare chests. Default is low.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.advancedSmi: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Diamond and Netherite upgrade templates in Legendary chests (Ancient Cities, Ominous Vaults, etc).
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.basicSmithi: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Iron and Gold upgrade templates in High-Tier chests (Bastions, Fortresses, etc).
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.blackVarian: The damp ones. Found in swamps, caves, and other places that are probably bad for your sinuses.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.blueVariant: The icy ones. Checked before all other colors. If a biome matches these rules, it will get blue hamsters, even if it also matches rules for other colors below.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.caveCheekLo: The chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a hamster spawning in a cave actually found something cool instead of just a rock. Applies ONLY to hamsters spawning in valid cave biomes or deep underground.
The shiny rocks, glowing berries, and industrial debris found in the cheeks of cave-dwelling hamsters. Spelunking rodents have expensive tastes.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.cheekPouchL: Configure the contents and rarity of wild hamster cheek pouch loot. Requires a world reload to apply.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.chocolateVa: The forest dwellers. If it's a generic forest and doesn't fit any of the fancy categories above, you'll probably find these guys.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.creamVarian: The sandy ones. For deserts, beaches, and birch forests. Don't ask why birch forests. They just like them.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.cucumberBus: Specific biome IDs where cucumbers can sprout. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:savanna'.
Convention tags for maximum mod-pack harmony. Format: 'namespace:tag_name', for example: 'adorablehamsterpets:is_temperate', which points to the 'c:is_temperate' convention tag.
Biomes where cucumbers are absolutely NOT allowed. Overrides everything else. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:ocean'.
Wild cucumbers, for when you need emergency salads in the savanna. Only changes fresh chunks.
Biome tags where cucumbers feel at home. Format: 'mod_id:tag_name', for example: 'minecraft:is_jungle'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.defaultChee: The chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a wild hamster spawns with the default junk (seeds, nuggets, carrots, etc). 0.5 = 50%.
The curated selection of pocket lint, seeds, and snacks that hamsters naturally forage. Edit this if you think hamsters should naturally forage for diamonds.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.desc: Control the rodent population density, where their food grows, and what they scavenge for. Changes here usually require a restart, or at least a deep breath. Note: If you join a server, its world gen settings will override yours.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enableGlowi: Enables the 'CasualAnimalEnjoyer' Protocol. A small chance for a random nearby sunflower to become a bioluminescent beacon at night— a reference to the Kikoriki cartoon, 'It Can't Be True' episode, around the 3:22 mark. Added upon request as a thank-you to CasualAnimalEnjoyer for their massive help with mod compatibility.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.enableNethe: Vanilla horse armor doesn't spawn in Netherite, but maybe you think that's stupid. Enable this to allow Netherite Hamster Armor to appear in chests.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.excludeBiom: A list of Biome Tags to NEVER allow spawns in. For excluding broad categories like Oceans or Rivers without listing every single ID. Overrides inclusions.
A list of specific biome IDs to NEVER allow spawns in, even if they match a tag. This overrides all other settings. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name'. For example, 'minecraft:plains'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.extraCheekL: The chance (0.0 to 1.0) that a wild hamster spawns with items from your Extra Loot list above. Independent of the default loot check.
A list of item IDs (e.g. 'minecraft:cookie') or tags (e.g. '#c:fruits') that wild hamsters can spawn with. If you want them to spawn with Nether Stars, this is where you make that bad decision.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.globalCheek: The overall probability (0.0 to 1.0) that ANY wild hamster has stuffed something in its face. Set to 0.0 to enforce strict economic austerity.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.glowingSunf: 1 in X random ticks (20 ticks per second). Lower = more likely. Higher = more rare. Note: This only runs at night.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.grayVariant: The rocky ones. For mountains, cliffs, and other places you're likely to twist an ankle.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.greenBeanBu: Specific biomes where beans sprout like gossip in chat. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:swamp'.
Convention tags for mod-friendly bean spam. Format: 'namespace:tag_name', for example: 'adorablehamsterpets:is_wet', which points to the 'c:is_wet' convention tag.
Absolutely no beans here, thank you very much. Overrides all other settings. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name', for example: 'minecraft:beach'.
Legumes with attitude. Tuned for that perfect mid-game caffeine hit. Only changes fresh chunks.
Biome tags for bean growth. Empty by default—choose wisely. Format: 'mod_id:tag_name', for example: 'minecraft:is_jungle'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.hamsterSpaw: How Many, Where, and How Often?  Note: Some of these settings require re-logging into your world to take effect.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.highTierArm: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Diamond hamster armor in high-level chests (End City, Nether Fortress).
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.includeBiom: A list of specific biome IDs to ALWAYS allow spawns in, even if they don't match the tags above. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name'. For example, 'minecraft:plains'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.lavenderVar: The magical ones. Checked after Blue, but before all others.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.lootSetting: Control the economy of hamster-related trash. Adjust chest loot rarities and define exactly what wild hamsters are stuffing in their faces. Requires a world reload to apply.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.maxGroupSiz: Maximum hamsters per spawn group. Because sometimes one just isn't cute enough.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.netheriteAr: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Netherite Hamster Armor in high-level chests. Only applies if the toggle above is ON. Don't be too liberal with it. Or do. See if I care.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.oakLeavesAc: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) for an Oak Leaf block to drop an Acorn when broken. Default is low, similar to Apples.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.seedLootCha: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Cucumber, Green Bean, or Sunflower seeds in general loot chests.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.spawnBiomeC: A list of convention biome tags where hamsters can spawn. Used for broad mod compatibility.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.spawnBiomeT: A list of biome tags where hamsters can spawn. Format: 'mod_id:tag_name'. For example, 'minecraft:is_forest'.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.spawnWeight: Adjusts hamster spawn frequency. Higher = more chaos. 1 = blissful silence.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.standardArm: Chance (0.0 to 1.0) to find Acorn, Iron, or Gold hamster armor in standard Dungeons, Temples, Mineshafts, etc.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sunflowerBi: A list of biome tags where these custom Sunflowers can replace vanilla ones. My custom union tag 'adorablehamsterpets:is_plains' points to 'c:is_plains', which provides wide compatibility with modded biomes.
Specific biome IDs where these sunflowers can replace the vanilla ones. Format: 'mod_id:biome_name'. They’re picky.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sunflowerRe: Higher = slower, lower = faster. Photosynthesis is hard, okay?
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.sunflowerSe: Custom sunflowers, because the vanilla ones just weren’t fabulous enough. Only changes fresh chunks.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.variantSpaw: For the aspiring digital zoologist. This is where you control exactly which hamster colors appear in which biomes. The system checks each color group below in order, from top to bottom (rarest to most common). The first base color that a biome qualifies for is the one that will spawn there. 'Why no settings for orange hamsters?' Because orange is the default fallback if no other rules match.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.whiteVarian: The snowy ones. Checked after Blue and Lavender.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildBushReg: Higher = slower, lower = faster. Makes perfect sense.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildCucumbe: 1 in X chunks. Lower numbers means cucumbers take over the planet.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.wildGreenBe: 1 in X chunks. Lower = beanpocalypse. For those of you in the back, it means they'll spam everywhere.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.worldGenMis: For The Aspiring Landscape Artist. Note: Most of these settings require re-logging into your world to take effect, and it's unlikely you will see changes in chunks that have already been generated.
adorablehamsterpets.worldgen.worldLoot.d:
Control the economy of hamster-related trash. Adjust chest loot rarities and define exactly what wild hamsters are stuffing in their faces. Requires a world reload to apply.

Wondering where each loot type spawns? Check the mod page or the Hamster Tips guidebook.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.husband: Your hamster successfully sniffed out diamonds! Wow! This mod is amazing!
Canine Aspirations?
That special Food Mix did the trick! Your hamster now deems you worthy of its cheek-based cargo services.
A Trustworthy Face
Those cheeks are at maximum capacity. Your hamster is either preparing for the apocalypse or just really, really likes snacks.
Chipmunk Aspirations
A complete portfolio of hamster beds. Your hamster now has better housing options than most villagers. You've peaked.
Leaf Bender Supreme
Transform a humble cucumber into Sliced Cucumber. Rodents go nuts for it.
The Bait
Whip up some Hamster Food Mix. This is a great opportunity to say 'peckish.' What a fun word.
Pocket Snacks
You've successfully assembled a slightly more organized pile of leaves. It's basically a five-star rodent resort.
Luxury Leaf Pile
You've successfully combined leaves, mulch, and some twigs. Your hamster will be thrilled. Or they might eat it. 50/50, really.
Artisanal Floor Mulch
You've automated the process of making a mess. Your commitment to laziness is noted and, frankly, respected.
High-Tech Allergy Attack
Cast responsibility to the wind by over-harvesting a tree until it stops giving acorns.
Ecological Menace
Upgrade to Diamond plating. Stops them from stealing your items; cheaper than counseling.
Expensive Therapy
Procure Green Bean Seeds. These aren't your average beans.
Green Bean Gardener
You've officially claimed a pile of leaves for your hamster. It's like a tiny, leafy mortgage.
Home is Where the Leaves Are
Your hamster has successfully navigated to its bed and passed out. A truly monumental achievement.
Sweet Dreams 'r Made of Leaves
Construct armor made of nuts. It completely negates damage by shattering instantly. A brilliant strategy.
Hardened Salad
Upgrade to Netherite plating. Knockback rules? More like... guidelines, Mrs. Turner.
The Immovable Object
That high-pitched noise wasn't your tinnitus. Your hamster thinks a Creeper fancies you. Run. Or don't. Your funeral.
Impending Doom Squeak
Apply heavy machinery to a small seed. It's violent, efficient, and creates sharp shrapnel. Perfect.
Industrial Nutcracking
What do you mean this just a good for nothing weed? It glows at night.
It Can't Be True!
Defeated by a... hamster. I definitely won't put that on your tombstone.
Rodent Reckoning
You killed a hamster. My only question is... why?
MURDERER
Your shoulder-mounted alarm system just detected... something shiny. Or possibly just lint. Good luck.
Nose for Treasure
You've subjected your hamster to floral... decor. Um, good job? Should you regret this aesthetic choice, a pair of shears might be key.
Petal Pusher
You looked at a perfectly functional hamster bed and thought, 'Needs more... inversion.' A bold choice. Questionable, but bold.
Australian Feng Shui
Your hamster, displaying remarkable self-preservation, raided its own cheek stash. Clever, or just really hungry?
Pocket Paramedic
Obtain an Acorn. Represents the absolute pinnacle of hamster foraging technology.
Return on Investnut
Welcome to your new life as a rodent enthusiast. I'm only slightly jealous.
The Hamster Life
Acquire Cucumber Seeds. The first step to gaining a tiny, squeaky companion.
Seed Money
Convince a hamster that your shoulder is prime real estate. Hint: Cheese helps.
Shoulder Surfer
Equip the Acorn Hat. Your hamsters cuteness has increased from infinity to... infinity squared.
Squirrel Cosplay
Cook up some Green Beans. They smell... suspiciously energizing.
Steamy Greens
Gather Sunflower Seeds. They look innocent, but they're part of a larger, fluffier scheme.
Sunflower Hoarder
Feed your hamster Steamed Green Beans and witness a temporary burst of... ambition.
Supercharged Squeaker
Successfully domesticate a wild hamster. May your ankles be ever safe.
A Furry Shadow
Unleash your shoulder trebuchet. Bonus points for direct Creeper hits. (No hamsters were *terminally harmed in the making of this feature.)
The Hamster Yeet™
Launch your hamster into an Oak tree. It's not abandonment if they come back with loot.
Tree Heist
You've discovered that hamster bedding doubles as a portable, eco-friendly confetti cannon. Your janitor will not be amused.
Interior Desecrator
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.recipes: Learned how to craft the Hamster Guide Book.
advancements.adorablehamsterpets.technic: You've crafted the sacred texts of hamster lore. Well done.
block.adorablehamsterpets.sunflower_bloc: Sometimes yields seeds... key recipe ingredients?
Requires time to replenish its seedy bounty.
block.adorablehamsterpets.wild_cucumber_: Drops seeds. Seeds that might help you make small friends.
Interact with it. Gently. It's sensitive.
block.adorablehamsterpets.wild_green_bea: Yields seeds. Seeds for... enhancement of certain small mammals.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.access: Your hamster lacks a crippling sense of vanity. Let's fix that.$(br2)This section details the latest in rodent runway fashion, from $(l:accessories/pink_petals)<dark_green><b>flower petals</> to $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>acorn hats</>.$(br2)You can even $(l:accessories/custom_accessories)<dark_green><b>suggest your own!</>
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.advanc: Your hamster can do more than just look adorable and eat your seeds.$(br2)This section covers the weird stuff. You know, the features that make you question the very fabric of blocky reality. If you thought the $(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>yeeting</> was strange, you're in for a treat.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.announ: Occasional news, surveys, and other important squeaks from the developer. MORE FUN THAN IT SOUNDS, I PROMISE.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.crops_: You can't build a hamster empire on an empty stomach.$(br2)This chapter covers the entire food chain, from foraging for wild seeds to cultivating $(l:crops_food/green_beans)<dark_green><b>performance-enhancing legumes</>.$(br2)Also, $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>Cheese</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.landin: $(br)So, you want hamsters?$(br2)An admirable, if slightly predictable, goal.$(br2)This guide contains dubious wisdom gleaned from watching small rodents. Use at your own risk.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.loot_a: If it isn't nailed down, it's yours.$(br2)If it <i>is</> nailed down, bring a crowbar.$(br2)This section details where to find hamster-related loot, whether in a chest or inside a rodent's face.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.should: Wield $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>Cheese</> near your tamed companion to have them hop on your shoulder. They might do cool things like alert you to nearby <dark_green><b>Creepers</> that have noticed you, or shiny <dark_aqua><b>Diamonds</>.$(br2)Listen for the unique squeaks and sniffs amongst your own panicked breathing.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.the_ha: So you've decided you need more squeaking in your life. <i>Excellent.</>$(br2)This chapter covers the essentials— finding them in the wild, the art of the vegetable bribe, and the finer points of convincing them to stay put.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.the_ki: You stepped into the right dimension, my friend.$(br2)Here you'll find the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<b>configuration menu</>, our $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<b>bustling online hamster fan club</>, and a <i>conveniently</> placed $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/support_the_mod)<b>donation box</>.$(br2)Rummage around.
book.adorablehamsterpets.category.update: What's new, what's fixed, and what's probably going to break next.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.acorn_hat: Shove the <dark_green><b>Acorn Hat</> into the $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</> slot to grant the Arboreal Affinity perk: double $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#intro)<dark_green><b>Tree Heist</> yields.$(br2)Perhaps looking like a nut helps them infiltrate the canopy unnoticed. Or maybe they just work harder when they feel pretty.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.basic_car: They follow.$(br2)Constantly.$(br2)Right-click your tamed hamster to make it <b>Sit/Stay</>.$(br2)It might doze off. If it does, that's on you. If you die from cuteness overload, that's also on you.

$(br)Tired of the constant stalking?$(br2)Craft a $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bed)<dark_green><b>Hamster Bed</>.$(br2)It has a faint aroma of stale cheese and forest floor debris— basically hamster crack. They'll hang around the bed instead of nipping at your heels. You're welcome.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.cheek_pou: Inventory... in their face. Feed them $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</> to earn cheek access. Then <b>Sneak + Right-click</> a tamed hamster for 6 slots of prime real estate.$(br2)If hurt, they can automatically eat the $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>food mix</> from their cheeks if available.

$(br)And no, you can't stuff a Netherite block in there. Your hamster's cheeks, while surprisingly spacious, are not a pocket dimension. They will refuse to store anything too bulky, pointy, or generally illogical.$(br2)Consult the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</> if you wish to re-define what constitutes 'illogical.'

The <dark_green><b>Bling</> and <dark_green><b>Armor</> slots provide manual control over $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Accessories</> and $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</>.$(br2)Strictly speaking, they are unnecessary since you can <i>also</> equip items by <b>right-clicking</>, and remove them by brandishing <b>Shears</>.

$(br)But I added them anyway.$(br2)You're welcome.$(br2)Anyway, civilized folks like yourself should <i>probably</> prefer using inventory slots rather than threatening their pets with garden tools.$(br2)Looking at you, John.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.cheese.pa: Not only is this delicacy ideal for tempting small rodents onto your person, you also eat it.$(br2)It's suspiciously nourishing and slips right down the old gullet more quickly than other foods, if you can stomach the... <i>moist sounds</>.
Yes, this is the alchemical process of transmuting a bucket of milk directly into three solid wedges of cheese. It's science. Don't question it.$(br2)(Turn page)
$(br)A more involved, thematically appropriate cheese-making process is planned for a future update.$(br2)$(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<b>Join the Discord</> to help shape the future!
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.config_he: Not a fan of earning your hamster's trust for cheek storage? Wish those tooltips would just vanish? Good news for the micromanagers: this mod is highly configurable. Tweak to your heart's content.$(br2)Or break everything. Your call.
$(br)For convenience, I coded a custom button so you can access the full configuration screen directly from this book.$(br2)No idea what a config is? Prepare for awesomeness.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.creeper_p: That panicked squeak? A <b>Creeper</> has targeted YOU. Not just nearby, <red><b><i>"targeting"</>.$(br2)Maybe your hamster is worried its comfy shoulder perch is about to vanish.
Find these <dark_green><b>Wild Cucumber Bushes</> lurking in warmer biomes.$(br2)Right-click a seeded one.$(br2)This is the first step on your path to hamster-fueled glory.
Plant the seeds.$(br2)Wait. Wait some more.$(br2)Harvest the <dark_green><b>Cucumber</>. Try not to starve while waiting.$(br2)You'll also get more seeds back, because that's how farming works.

Craft a cucumber to get the coveted <dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>.$(br2)This is the primary currency for $(l:the_hamster_life/taming)<b>taming</> a wild hamster and can also be used for $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding)<b>healing</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.custom_ac: The current accessory collection is... sparse, but the hamster haberdashery is just getting started!$(br2)I have tons of accessory ideas, due to people being generally awesome.$(br2)Got your own genius idea for the next     accessory

that absolutely <i>needs</> to exist?$(br2)Pop over to the official Discord server: $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/join_the_discord)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch</>.$(br2)And while you're there, come share screenshots of your cute hamsters! (I can't get enough of those).
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.feeding.p: If your hamster has had a disagreement with, well, anything— feed it seeds or basic crops to patch it up.$(br2)For serious healing, craft $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</>. It is quite irresistible.
If its healthy, the same basic food might trigger... <b>Love Mode</>.$(br2)Find another hamster also in Love Mode.$(br2)Stand back. Nature happens.

Do not feed it the same mundane food twice in a row. It has standards. It will refuse.$(br2)Exceptions: $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</> (gourmet stuff) and $(l:crops_food/green_beans#item)<dark_green><b>Steamed Green Beans</>.

Those $(l:crops_food/green_beans#item)<dark_green><b>Steamed Green Beans</>? Just smelt some regular Green Beans. They grant Speed, Strength, Absorption & Regen for a bit. Impressive!$(br2)...But there is a cooldown before it works again. Less impressive.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.green_bea: Find these <dark_green><b>Wild Green Bean Bushes</> in temperate or wet areas. Right-click to procure seeds.$(br2)These aren't your garden-variety legumes.
Plant the seeds, wait for the magic to happen, then harvest your <dark_green><b>Green Beans</>.$(br2)Simple.

Smelt Green Beans in a furnace to create <dark_green><b>Steamed Green Beans</>.$(br2)These can be used for $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding)<dark_green><b>healing</>, and— much more importantly— for commencing the awe-inspiring $(l:the_hamster_life/feeding#buffs)<dark_green><b>Hamster Zoomies</>.
Yes, you smelt it. Makes perfect sense.$(br2)A more... intuitive steaming method is planned for a future update, maybe involving a multi-block structure... and water buckets? We shall see.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_b: For when 'following you into lava' is no longer a desirable trait.$(br2)Craft some $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bedding)<dark_green><b>Hamster Bedding</> and combine it with wood planks to create a five-star rodent hangout, which serves as an anchor for $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#wander_mode)<dark_green><b>Tamed Wander Mode</>.
I'll let you figure out the other 4 recipes.$(br2)You're smart. You got this.$(br2)P.S.- Don't place the beds upside down. <i>Wink.</>

Once you've placed the bed <i>(not upside down),</> you're now the proud operator of a tiny, leafy command center:$(br2)• <b>Right-click</> to toggle Wander Mode on/off.$(br2)• <b>$(k:sneak) + Right-click</> to cycle wander distance.

$(br)• Use $(l:crops_food/cheese)<gold><b>Cheese</> to lure them to bed for a nap.$(br2)• Use <b>Rotten Flesh</> to make the bed... unappealing, preventing sleep.$(br2)• <b>$(k:sneak) + Rotten Flesh</> to unlink the bed entirely.$(br2)Breaking the bed also disables Wander Mode.$(br2)Duh.

If you or your server moderator enable 'Respawn in Bed' in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>, this bed can become a respawn point.$(br2)When your hamster meets its inevitable, physics-based demise, it will simply rematerialize here.

$(br)Preserves their inventory, but not self-confidence. Brief therapy may be required.$(br2)<b><i>Note</>: if you're using an external mod that gives your pets super powers, that sort of data may not be preserved since I haven't manually encoded it.

Hamster stuck or lost while wandering? No problem. Simply go to sleep in your own bed. During the night, they will utilize <i>rodent determination</> to sneak home.$(br2)You'll wake up to find them sound asleep, pretending they didn't just teleport.

Here it is: the primary ingredient for the $(l:advanced_rodentry/hamster_bed#hamster_bed)<dark_green><b>Hamster Bed</>.$(br2)It also doubles as a portable, eco-friendly confetti cannon, but you didn't hear that from me.
You'll need to combine:$(br)1. The finest debris the forest has to offer.$(br)2. Some twigs.$(br2)The result: incredible artisanal floor mulch.
Ahh yes. The hamster bed.$(br2)It can be spiritually, emotionally, and digitally bonded to a single hamster.$(br2)The link can also be undone if you fused the bed to the wrong$(br)   hamster.
<b>Right-click</> your tamed hamster with the bed item in hand to link them.$(br2)Now your hamster will blissfully ignore you and roam freely within range of the bed.
Match your base, or clash horribly. Your$(br)   choice.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_f: Craft this. Or don't. Your hamster, your problem.$(br2)But anyway, it heals well and crucially, is one of the few items they'll never refuse, even if fed repeatedly. It's also the key to convincing them that their face is a perfectly viable $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<b>storage solution</>.
$(br)Failure to follow these instructions precisely may result in the accidental creation of a new form of sentient gravel.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.hamster_l: Wild hamsters are nature's vacuum cleaners. About 50%% of them spawn with their cheek pouches containing whatever floor debris they could fit inside.$(br2)Expect to find $(l:crops_food)<dark_green><b>Seeds</>, nuggets, veggies, and other small trinkets. They're shy, so bring$(br)   $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>bribes</>.

$(br)Don't like their hoarding habits? Think they should be scavenging for Nether Stars instead of Wheat Seeds?$(br2)I anticipated your need for control. You can configure exactly what items they spawn with and the rarity of those items in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.how_acces: Your hamster possesses a dedicated inventory slot labeled '$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</>'. Yes, that is the technical term. No, I won't change it.$(br2)<b>Right-Click</> your hamster with accessory to equip it. Or, if you prefer micromanagement, open their $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches)<dark_green><b>inventory</> and place it manually.

$(br)There is also a separate '$(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Armor</>' slot. It functions exactly how you'd expect.$(br2)Pro-tip: The base Acorn Armor <i>also</> includes the hat for aesthetics, but if you want to get the Arboreal Affinity perk, you must equip the separate $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Acorn Hat</> accessory in the Bling slot.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.join_the_: Got a genius idea for the next hamster accessory? Want to share screenshots of your furry army? Or maybe you just want to see what's coming next?$(br2)Pop over to the official Discord server:$(br)<gold><b><i>The Cheek Pouch.</>
$(br)I've got channels for suggestions, bug reports, screenshots, and even a showcase for your real-life pets.$(br2)Come help shape the future of the mod!
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.missing_b: Misplaced this invaluable tome of rodent wisdom, or need another one?$(br2)Shocking.$(br2)$(c:/function adorablehamsterpets:player/give_book_to_self)<b>Click here</>, or craft another with a vanilla <b>Book</> and some $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>.
Don't ask why Sliced Cucumber.$(br2)It's a long story involving a very particular hamster and an unfortunate water polo incident.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.pink_peta: Stumbled upon some <pink><b>Pink Petals</>? Try <b>right-clicking</> your hamster with them. It's called fashion— look it up.$(br2)Click again to change the position; use shears or the $(l:advanced_rodentry/cheek_pouches#equipment_slots)<dark_green><b>Bling</> slot to remove them.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.psycholog: Your hamster exudes an aura of pure, unadulterated menace that is apparently only perceptible to giant <b>Spiders</> and angry horned <b>Ravagers</>.$(br2)Use this knowledge to your advantage— watch as the Ravager desperately flees from something that is
$(br)small enough to accidentally be snorted up its nostril.$(br2)Wait... perhaps that's what the Ravager is so afraid of?$(br2)This needs further investigation.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.regional_: Word on the block is, hamsters adapt. Expect different fur stylings depending on where they originated.$(br2)Some coats are more... <b><i>exclusive</> than others.$(br2)Breeding can sometimes result in new white markings.
<light_gray><i>The other 69 variants were uncooperative during the shoot.</>
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.subterran: Those excited sniffs? Your pocket prospector smells <dark_aqua><b>Diamonds!</> Checks a 10-block radius by default.$(br2)It pauses between alerts, so listen carefully before you start digging... again.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.sunflower: These aren't your average, purely decorative sunflowers. Right-click a seeded one to harvest <dark_green><b>Sunflower Seeds</>— a key ingredient for the $(l:crops_food/hamster_food_mix)<dark_green><b>Hamster Food Mix</>.$(br2)Use <b>Bone Meal</> or plant the seeds to create more.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.support_t: Adorable Hamster Pets began as a weekend project for my wife and quickly grew into a passion. My goal is to be able to dedicate more of my week to adding features, fixing bugs, and dreaming up new mods.$(br2)I'm a one-person show, and every coffee you buy helps me trade a

$(br)bit of my 'day job' for full-time hamster-wrangling and code-slinging.$(br2)If you enjoy the mod and want to chip in, please consider buying me a coffee! Thanks for helping me make more cool stuff.               :)
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.taming.pa: First, you need bait.$(br2)The good stuff comes from $(l:crops_food/cucumber)<dark_green><b>Cucumbers</>.$(br2)Find $(l:crops_food/cucumber#bush)<dark_green><b>Wild Cucumber Bushes</> in warmer places — plains, savannas, maybe jungle edges.$(br2)<b>Right-click</> 'em for seeds.

Plant those $(l:crops_food/cucumber#crop)<dark_green><b>Cucumber Seeds</> on farmland. Once grown, harvest the $(l:crops_food/cucumber#crop)<dark_green><b>Cucumbers</>.$(br2)Now, the crucial step: craft the cucumber into $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>. This is what the little fuzzballs actually I want.

$(br)Right, the actual taming.$(br2)Remember: <b>Sneak</>(<b>$(k:sneak)</>).$(br2)Hold $(l:crops_food/cucumber#item)<dark_green><b>Sliced Cucumber</>.$(br2)Approach slowly. Hope it doesn't notice your desperation.$(br2)Repeat until furry friend acquired.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.the_hamst: For when words fail and you need a furry, surprisingly aerodynamic solution. Aim (don't stare right at a block), press <b>$(k:adorablehamsterpets.throw_hamster)</>.$(br2)Conveniently, it does exactly enough damage to kill a creeper in one blow. Hamster passes out upon impact. Go console it.

$(br)Is <b>$(k:adorablehamsterpets.throw_hamster)</> not throwing your hamster?$(br2)Did you add this mod to an existing world? Woopsy.$(br2)Go to: <b>Options > Controls > Key Binds</>. Find <gold><b>"Throw Hamster,"</> and set it to <b>G</> (or your preferred key).
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tiny_pros: So, your shoulder-mounted companion just alerted you to nearby $(l:advanced_rodentry/subterranean_shinies)<dark_aqua><b>Diamonds</>? Excellent.$(br2)Now for the fun part. Dismount your tiny prospector. If it was indeed onto something shiny, it might just take matters into its own feet.
$(br)Watch as it attempts to lead you to the alleged riches.$(br2)But be warned: diamonds smell very similar to... well, um gold, which can be confusing for hamsters. Prepare for tiny drama.
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.tree_heis: Acorn Armor

To obtain hamster armor, start by $(l:shoulder_hamsters/the_hamster_yeet)<dark_green><b>throwing</> your hamster at some Oak Leaves (or dismount near them) to initiate a <dark_green><b>Tree Heist</>.$(br2)They will vanish into the canopy, rustle around, and occasionally toss out <dark_green><b>Acorns</> until the tree is depleted.
<light_gray><i>Me and the boys$(br)   preparing for war</>

Trees have memory. Rob the same oak too many times, and it stops giving up the goods.$(br2)It takes about a day for the ecosystem to forgive you.$(br2)Can't wait? There's a 'Reset History' button in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>.
The Acorn Economy

Think nature is too stingy? I added a slider in the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</> just for you.$(br2)Crank up the 'Acorn Drop Chance' if you want it to rain nuts (limit: 1 per second).$(br2)Just don't blame me when your inventory overflows.
Market Manipulation

The <dark_green><b>Acorns</>? Useless on their own, unless you enjoy composting and choking hazards.$(br2)Process them in a <b>Stonecutter</> to create $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Acorn Shards</>, used for $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</> or the stylish $(l:accessories/acorn_hat)<dark_green><b>Acorn Hat</>.
The Loot
Combine the shards with the hat to create <dark_green><b>Acorn Armor</>.$(br2)Completely blocks incoming attack damage until it runs out of durability.
Hardened Salad
So just like wolf$(br)   armor, but more$(br)   adorable.

Armor made of nuts is decent. Armor made of magic nuts is better.$(br2)Slap it in an Enchanting Table for <b>Unbreaking</> and <b>Fire Protection</>.$(br2)The second one prevents armored hamsters from being roasted in lava.
Magical Rodents

Use Enchanted Books and Anvils to add <b>Mending</>, <b>Frost Walker</> and <b>Soul Speed</>.$(br2)<light_gray><i>Note: Protection and Feather Falling are pointless and disabled. The armor is already a damage shield, and hamsters don't take fall damage. Don't be greedy.</>
Book Learning

Found a <dark_green><b>Hamster Smithing Template</> in a loot chest? Excellent.$(br2)Use a Smithing Table to plate the <dark_green><b>Armor</> with your shinies.$(br2)Each material offers...     <i>unique</> advantages.
Military Upgrades

<light_gray><b>Iron:</> Reduces wind resistance, increasing throw velocity.$(br)<gold><b>Gold:</> Grants a permanent Speed boost.$(br)<dark_purple><b>Netherite:</> Turns the hamster into a dense object. Grants Knockback Resistance and significantly increased throw damage.
Upgrade Perks I

<dark_aqua><b>Diamond:</> This is the expensive therapy option.$(br2)Cover hamster in shiny rock; hamster be good.$(br2)A diamond-clad hamster will be so utterly satisfied that it will eagerly fetch things for you instead of running away with$(br)   them.
Upgrade Perks II
book.adorablehamsterpets.entry.world_loo: Hamster-related loot can be found contaminating various places. You can find basic items like $(l:crops_food)<dark_green><b>Seeds</>, common $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#acorn_armor)<dark_green><b>Armor</> types, (acorn, iron, gold) rotting away in:$(br2)• Villages/Outposts$(br)• Mineshafts/Dungeons$(br)• Shipwrecks/Ruins$(br)• Pyramids/Temples$(br)• Ruined Portals

$(br)Looking for $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#diamond_perk)<dark_green><b>Diamond Armor</> or smithing $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#upgrades)<dark_green><b>Templates</>? Stop digging and start raiding. They prefer danger:$(br2)• Fortresses/Bastions$(br)• End Cities$(br)• Strongholds$(br)• Trial Chambers$(br2)If you enabled $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#perks)<dark_green><b>Netherite Armor</> loot in the config, it spawns there too.

$(br)Legendary items like $(l:accessories)<dark_green><b>Accessories</> and advanced smithing $(l:advanced_rodentry/tree_heist_and_armor#upgrades)<dark_green><b>Templates</> are hoarded in the annoying locations:$(br2)• Ancient Cities$(br)• Woodland Mansions$(br)• Stronghold Libraries$(br)• Buried Treasure$(br)• Ominous Spawners$(br2)Bring a weapon. Or sacrifice a friend.

$(br)Don't like the drop rates? Think Hamster Armor is too rare or too common?$(br2)Check the $(l:the_kitchen_drawer/config_heaven)<dark_green><b>Config</>.$(br2)You can tweak the spawn chance for every category of loot, enable Netherite Armor drops, or disable world loot entirely if you hate fun.
